disambiguation: Not a graph visualization tool; it generates a consolidated text summary of your notes.
intentEvidence: Vault Summary is a powerful Obsidian plugin that allows you to compile multiple Markdown files—or your entire vault—into a single, well-structured text document.
motivation: To generate context files that package interconnected thoughts into a format AI can easily parse.
problem: Compiling interconnected notes into a format suitable for Large Language Models (LLMs) or external analysis is complex.
summary: Vault Summary compiles an entire vault or selected notes into a single, structured text file by traversing the note graph.
